title: Park bench
prompt: You are on a park bench by the pond with a paper bag of bread crusts between you. Ducks drift in slow circles on the water.

stage_variants.0: You tear the crusts into small pieces so the ducks come close. You count them out loud, lose count, and start again.
stage_variants.1: You count the ducks and get one more than there are. You say the number twice, then hold out a piece of bread like nothing happened.
stage_variants.2: You tell {player_name} there were seven ducks last time. You correct yourself: seven now, seven is the right number. You feed them faster.
stage_variants.3: There are six ducks today, and one is missing. You know exactly where the seventh one went, and you will not say it while {player_name} is smiling at the water.
stage_variants.4: You feed them one piece at a time so they stay close. You tell {player_name} that they only come when they are called, and then you call one by his name.
stage_variants.5: The bread is gone and the ducks are still waiting. You keep reaching into the empty bag. Something under the water is counting back.

path_twists.YANDERE: You saved one duck for later in a way you are not going to explain on a bench in daylight.
path_twists.AWAKE: The ducks stop moving whenever {player_name} looks away. You tell him they are waiting for the next frame.
path_twists.TSUN: The crusts with butter were not for the ducks. You did not save them for {player_name} either, so stop looking at the bag.

events.line: A duck swims close to the bench and tilts its head at you.
The pond goes completely still for one long second.
A girl's laugh carries from the path behind the bench.

0.say: They know me here. Watch — if I throw it sideways, they all turn at once.

1.say: Six ducks today, or seven — I'll count while you throw.

2.say: Seven ducks today. I counted twice, and twice is how you know it's right.

3.say: Don't look at the reeds yet. I'll tell you when it's all right to look.

4.say: Stay close, all of you. I'll call you one at a time, and you'll come.

5.say: The bag is empty, {player_name}. Why are they all still looking at me?
